---
title: "Top IPD & OPD  Diagnoses"
format: docx
params:
  clinic_ward: "Neurosurgery Ward"
  admission_month_w: "Jan"
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(scales)
library(readxl)
library(janitor)
library(questionr)
library(stringr)
#library(icd)
library(lubridate)
library(haven)
library(flextable)
library(gt)
library(gtExtras)
library(webshot2)
library(glue)
```

```{r}
#| label: data
#| include: false

ipd_dx1 <- re("")
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-jan

dx_name_jan <- ipd_dx1 |>
  filter(clinic_ward == params$clinic_ward & admission_month_w == "Jan") |>
  filter(!is.na(disease_name)) |>
  group_by(disease_name) |>
  summarise(N = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(desc(N)) |>
  slice_head(n = 10) |>
  select(disease_name, N)

table1 <- flextable(dx_name_jan) |>
  set_header_labels(
    disease_name = "Major Disease Name/ICD-10",
    N = "Frequency"
  ) |>
  autofit()
```

######   `r params$clinic_ward`  Jan, 2025

```{r}
table1
```
